releases.title: PXA 1.0.0
releases.summary: The first versioned Power Dox Automation release combines authenticated document design, persistent templates, PDF and spreadsheet workflows, migration tooling, administration, localization, and production observability.

added: Versioned product release notes and build information.
Central feature maturity metadata for Alpha, Beta, and Stable capabilities.
A notification center for releases and important account or system events.
Production logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and alerting foundations.
improved: Designer navigation, authentication, template persistence, localization, and scrollable editing workflows.
Account, administration, licensing, mail, documentation, and deployment workflows.
security: Feature preferences and notifications are evaluated in the authenticated user and organization context.
Operational telemetry applies tenant-safe privacy and sanitization boundaries.
